env.doc: Read-only host environment snapshot. / 只读宿主环境快照。
env.types:
export type Version = { string: string, major: number, minor: number, patch: number }
export type Environment = { app: { name: string, author: string, version: Version }, qt: { version: Version }, locale: string }

i18n.doc: Locale-neutral dictionaries with parent-tag fallback. / 与语种无关的词典，按语言标签逐级回退。
i18n.types:
export type Catalog = { [string]: { [string]: string } }
export type Translator = (source: string, ...any) -> string

icons.doc: Theme-aware standard icons; GUI required. / 主题感知标准图标，需要 GUI。

bytes.doc: Strict hexadecimal and string/buffer conversions. / 严格十六进制及字节转换。

base64.doc: Canonical padded Base64. / 带填充的规范 Base64。

lz4.doc: LZ4 block format; bounded decompression. / LZ4 块格式及有界解压。

binary.doc: Fixed binary layouts; offsets are zero based. / 固定二进制布局，偏移从零开始。

exports.register_cffi: (name: string, ffi: any, ctype: string, definition: Definition) -> Schema
exports.decode: (schema: string | Schema, source: string | buffer | Source, offset: number?, options: Options?) -> Result
exports.encode: (schema: string | Schema, values: {[string]: any}, original: (string | buffer)?, options: Options?) -> string

analysis.doc: Scoped document parsing, transactional writes and annotations. / 作用域文档解析、事务写回与标注。
analysis.types:
local binary = require("@s/binary")
local hexdoc = require("@s/hexdoc")
export type Document = hexdoc.Document
export type AnnotationOptions = { title: string?, offset: number?, tr: ((source: string) -> string)? }

exports.transaction: <R...>(document: Document, title: string, callback: () -> R...) -> R...
exports.read: (document: Document, schema: string | binary.Schema, offset: number?, options: binary.Options?) -> binary.Result
exports.write: (document: Document, result: binary.Result, values: {[string]: any}?, title: string?) -> binary.Result

binaryreader.doc: Bounded random-access PE/ELF parser plans. / PE/ELF 有界随机读取和标注计划。

mcp/init.doc: MCP 2026-07-28 server with explicit HTTP lifetime. / 显式 HTTP 生命周期的 MCP 服务。

winghex.doc: Read-only native host module, loaded with @b/winghex. / 只读宿主模块，使用 @b/winghex 加载。
winghex.types:
local environment = require("@s/env_api")
local icons = require("@s/icons_api")
export type Environment = environment.Environment
export type IconIds = icons.IconIds
